name: @civitai/agent-runner
description: A durable runner for <civitai-chat>'s remote mode: replies run as DBOS workflows on Postgres, served over the chat's runner protocol (start, events, stop, patch).
comment-packaging: @civitai/components-chat is a PEER with an explicit range, not workspace:^: the page and the runner must speak one runner protocol, so the deployment brings its own copy, and an explicit range is never left by a components-chat minor, so changesets does not force this package to a major (see the same choice for @civitai/sdk in components-chat). The floor, 0.25.0, is the version the runner core was moved out of civitai against. @dbos-inc/dbos-sdk is pinned exactly: the golden test pins the DBOS calls a reply makes, which is what a recovered run replays against. @types/pg is a dependency because the public declarations name pg's types. `!dist/**/*.map` keeps dangling sourcemaps out of the tarball (#376).
